spec-agent.description: Writes and enforces SPEC.md. Ensures spec-first discipline. Validates that implementation matches spec before any file is written.

walker-ranker-agent.description: Implements recursive file discovery, noise detection, and multi-signal relevance scoring against the task description.

bundler-agent.description: Owns token counting, budget management, truncation policy, and bundle assembly into final markdown format.

manifest-cli-agent.description: Implements the exact CLI contract (argparse), all exit codes, error messages, and the manifest JSON schema.

qa-edge-agent.description: Owns all edge cases: binary files, non-UTF-8, empty dirs, single file larger than budget, repeat-run byte-identical determinism, 3000-file performance.
